messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT (P1): Customer VPC 'cedar-prod' experiencing GPU capacity exhaustion and autoscaler stall. Queue length rising, paging on-call @mira and infra. Trigger: sustained pending requests > 1k, scale attempts failing.

mira: seeing alerts, joining. what's the current queue size?

ashwin: queue ~1,140 requests for model rwd-gpt-xl on pool cedar-gpu-a, avg token latency spiking to ~1.8s. Autoscaler logs show repeated 'node-provision-timeout' for new nodes.

mira: any error lines from the node bootstrap? paste logs pls.

ashwin: paste below — the nodes get stuck on image pull + KMS mount.

ashwin: ```
Event: Failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to pull image "prod-gpu-runtime:2026-02-10": context deadline exceeded
cloud-init: error mounting keyring: timed out contacting KMS
Autoscaler: node create attempted (id=cedar-tn-xx), status=PROVISIONING -> TIMEOUT after 12m
```

infra-auto: autoscaler retry policy at 3 attempts, backoff 30s. Provisioning failures bumped to `scale_limit` because cloud account hit async quota for network interfaces in that az.

mira: ok that matches. So two constraints: (1) customer VPC AZ has NIC quota hitting transient limit, (2) image pull/KMS handshake adding >5m to node bootstrap, pushes past autoscaler timeout -> autoscaler gives up and marks pool saturated.

nitya: customer-ops here — Cedar's infra team confirmed they had an infra rollout earlier that reduced available NICs in use. They're provisioning additional quota but ETA ~45m. They're OK with a temporary config change.

mira: mitigation plan: 1) open temporary fallback routing to move low-priority requests to hosted-run (redwood-hosted) 2) increase autoscaler timeout and attempts for cedar pool to tolerate slow boot 3) manual hot-provision up to 3 pre-warmed nodes (if cloud quotas allow) 4) inform customer and enable degraded-mode tickets. Who can toggle routing?

ashwin: I can flip routing policy: change route weight for cedar-prod->0.6 and hosted->0.4 for non-committed customers. patch below: 

ashwin: ```bash
# patch route policy
redwoodctl routes set-weight --cluster cedar-prod --model rwd-gpt-xl --weights "hosted:40,dedicated:60"
```

mira: do that. also set autoscaler timeout to 20m and max retries to 6 for cedar pool: 

mira: ```yaml
# autoscaler override
pool: cedar-gpu-a
bootstrapTimeout: 1200s
maxCreateRetries: 6
```

infra-auto: applying autoscaler override now. note: this will delay failure detection, but should let slow nodes join instead of marking saturated.

ashwin: routing change applied. traffic split now: hosted 42% / dedicated 58% (non-SLA routes). queue immediately dropped by ~250 requests.

customer-ops: notified cedar infra team and customer success. customer acknowledged and accepted degraded perf while we remediate.

nitya: I started manual hot-provision attempt for 2 nodes via console. First one failed with same KMS mount timeout, second pending. If quota freed we'll get them online.

mira: good. I'm also enabling prefix-KV caching for this workload to reduce token regen — small perf win.

ashwin: metrics: GPU util at 89% on running nodes, queue slowly decreasing now (~820). Autoscaler logs show a few successes after timeout bump — three nodes registered in last 14m.

mira: set incident state to 'mitigating', assigning long-running owner @mira. escalation: if queue > 700 for 30m, page infra-eng-sre and exec on-call.

oncall-bot: REMINDER: please fill incident timeline + customer impact in pagerduties after handoff.

customer-ops: customer impact note: inference latency increased 2x for a subset of requests, low-volume tail latency spikes. No data loss. Customer-facing ticket ID: CUST-8952.
